item.title: Emilia Clarke is Done with the Fantasy Genre After Game of Thrones
item.description: As part of a press tour for her new Peacock espionage series Ponies, Emilia Clarke told The New York Times that she is more or less done with the fantasy genre after spending eight years on HBO’s Game of Thrones, but there was no mention of Star Wars in the interview.
